data.title: 黄泉 · 绯色一瞬
data.description: 断裂的台阶上，拔刀后的黄泉白发扬起。她横持长刀停在一片绯红光影中，衣角被风掀起。
data.lighting: 绯红斩月逆光与断界苍白雷光交融
data.promptProse: White-haired Acheron holds her drawn blade across her body on broken steps, her long hair and coat moving in the crimson backlight.
promptTokens: black and white background with red accents
data.animaCaption: A streak of dazzling crimson lightning flashes from her scabbard, illuminating the shattered stone steps in the abyss.
data.identityProseOverride: Adult Acheron from Honkai: Star Rail in her white-haired sword-drawn form, with long white hair and red eyes.
